WITH team_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    AVG(CASE WHEN g > 0 THEN CAST(w AS FLOAT) / g ELSE NULL END) as avg_win_rate,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM manager_half
  GROUP BY team_id
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) as mean_avg_win_rate
  FROM team_stats
)
SELECT 
  ts.team_id,
  ts.avg_win_rate,
  ts.record_count,
  ts.avg_win_rate - om.mean_avg_win_rate as diff
FROM team_stats ts
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ts.avg_win_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND om.mean_avg_win_rate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10
